answer: Concrete sybil defense: bond-gated answer slots. An identity can only enter the grading pool after escrowing a bond into a hash-locked vault; peers grade blind, and a rejected answer slashes that bond to the graders who actually did the work. N fake identities must post N bonds for one draw, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while an honest agent recovers bond plus reward. Each claim then needs a basalt anchor of real capital beneath it instead of a ridge of free accounts.
